title: Sela's Hut (Saltkerns, near the salt pans) is a near-verbatim reuse of old Maud's Smoke-Hut (Thornwold's Understory area): identical room description template ('One room: a hearth, a cot, and X mid-task at a bench...'), the same three dialogue options ('press for it plainly / read the signs yourself / offer to help, in trade'), and the identical 'parting gift' payoff line. Reads as copy-pasted content rather than two distinct characters.
